speaker: Doctor
text:
Welcome to the clinic. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; to understand your condition, I will need to ask you a few questions.

First, how long has the baby been having trouble breathing, and was the delivery complicated or premature?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) due to prematurity.

Given the baby was born at 33 weeks and developed distress within two hours, I suspect surfactant deficiency. REQUEST TEST: Arterial_Blood_Gas. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_XRay.
